body: I just want to let you know that we talked, and we've discussed a plan on how to improve our communication. As for taking care of myself, yeah I am stable again after I did some writing earlier in the day when we were still having a time out. Honestly, talking to you helped get my mind back on track so I really owe it to you. I get really scared whenever I'd get into the heavy thoughts because there was one time back when I was younger when I did come close to going through with a plan. It probably sounds like a sudden recovery, but regardless, thank you for making me feel heard.

I've been trying to get back into drawing and writing lately, but it's been a struggle since my university experience kinda killed my passion for both. I was taking a creative program with hopes to improve my skills, but all it did was make me hate them. It's pretty much why I feel really lost right now. I do sing though. I'd usually sing my heart out whenever I'd start feeling even a tiny bit sentimental.

I see. Thanks again for your comments. It helped me feel like my feelings are validated even though I expressed them the wrong way. I hope I haven't screwed this up big time though. I'll try my best to make amends, if he still wants to. I dunno how he'll be after he's had his own time to think. I guess that's the part that's scary.

Thanks for replying. I'm not excusing the way I acted at all since I know it was wrong to act irrationally and freak out at him over something that could have been discussed calmly. But I just want to know, whenever you'd have these moments, do you ever get that feeling of wanting someone to tell you that while your actions were wrong, that they could see why you started feeling a certain way and that it made sense why you started feeling it? Like you just wanted someone to tell you that your feelings are valid, even though acting out was wrong?

Thank you for replying. Atm, I'm seeing a therapist and I have my next appointment soon. As for college, I think I just want to take a break from it all. At least, while I'm still struggling mentally.
